comparison.objective: Release, swing, and extend a car sun visor to cover a window band; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequential manipulation of clip, swivel, roll, and slide joints differs from concentric driver/wrench torque coordination.
comparison.success_condition: At least 80% band coverage after release versus a precise opening limit locked without drift and cycle-verified.
comparison.reason: Articulated motion is shared only generically; the tested abilities and end states differ.
